{{Top}}
The '''stasis-type shield generator''' was a specific type of [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] generator. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] had such a generator, manufactured by [[Novaldex/Legends|Novaldex]], as part of its shielding system during its ownership by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].
